verdict.rationale: The evidence centers on Pipedream MCP serving on-demand tool calls to agents with managed auth. The only hint of background automation is the app listing showing '4 triggers', which suggests event-driven execution but is never explained as autonomous scheduled or background runs. Missing for 10: documented setup of background or scheduled automations, an explanation of how triggers fire workflows without a user in the loop, monitoring of autonomous runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
